test.create_query: CREATE TABLE join_or_build (k1 UInt64, k2 UInt64, k3 UInt64, k4 UInt64, n1 Nullable(UInt64), n2 Nullable(UInt64), t UInt32, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE join_or_build_small (k1 UInt64, k2 UInt64, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE join_or_build_dups (k1 UInt64, k2 UInt64, t UInt32, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory

CREATE TABLE join_or_probe (rare UInt64, often UInt64, half UInt64, half2 UInt64, half3 UInt64, small UInt64, small2 UInt64, n1 Nullable(UInt64), n2 Nullable(UInt64), t UInt32, same UInt64, same2 UInt64, same3 UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO join_or_build SELECT number, number, number, number, if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, number), if(number % 10 = 1, NULL, number), number % 16, number FROM numbers_mt(2000000)
INSERT INTO join_or_build_small SELECT number, number, number FROM numbers(10000)
INSERT INTO join_or_build_dups SELECT intDiv(number, 4), intDiv(number, 4), number % 16, number FROM numbers_mt(2000000)

INSERT INTO join_or_probe SELECT intHash64(number * 32) % 40000000, intHash64(number * 32 + 1) % 2100000, intHash64(number * 32 + 2) % 4000000, intHash64(number * 32 + 3) % 4000000, intHash64(number * 32 + 4) % 4000000, intHash64(number * 32 + 7) % 20000, intHash64(number * 32 + 8) % 20000, if(number % 10 = 2, NULL, intHash64(number * 32 + 5) % 4000000), if(number % 10 = 3, NULL, intHash64(number * 32 + 6) % 4000000), number % 16, if(intHash64(number * 32 + 20) % 2 = 1, 0, 2000000) + intHash64(number * 32 + 9) % 2000000, if(intHash64(number * 32 + 20) % 2 = 1, 0, 2000000) + intHash64(number * 32 + 10) % 2000000, if(intHash64(number * 32 + 20) % 2 = 1, 0, 2000000) + intHash64(number * 32 + 11) % 2000000 FROM numbers_mt(20000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l INNER JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.half = r.k1 OR l.half2 = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l INNER JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.half = r.k1 OR l.half2 = r.k2 OR l.half3 = r.k3 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l INNER JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.half = r.k1 OR l.half2 = r.k2 OR l.half3 = r.k3 OR l.often = r.k4 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT sum(r.v) FROM join_or_probe AS l LEFT JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.half = r.k1 OR l.half2 = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT sum(r.v) FROM join_or_probe AS l ANY LEFT JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.rare = r.k1 OR l.half = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT sum(r.v) FROM join_or_probe AS l ANY LEFT JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.often = r.k1 OR l.half = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l LEFT SEMI JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.rare = r.k1 OR l.half = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l LEFT SEMI JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.often = r.k1 OR l.half = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l LEFT ANTI JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.rare = r.k1 OR l.half = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l LEFT ANTI JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.often = r.k1 OR l.half = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l LEFT JOIN join_or_build_dups AS r ON l.half = r.k1 AND l.t < r.t FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l LEFT JOIN join_or_build_dups AS r ON (l.half = r.k1 OR l.half2 = r.k2) AND l.t < r.t FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l INNER JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.n1 = r.n1 OR l.n2 = r.n2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l INNER JOIN join_or_build_small AS r ON l.small = r.k1 OR l.small2 = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l LEFT SEMI JOIN join_or_build_small AS r ON l.small = r.k1 OR l.small2 = r.k2 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
SELECT count() FROM join_or_probe AS l INNER JOIN join_or_build AS r ON l.same = r.k1 OR l.same2 = r.k2 OR l.same3 = r.k3 FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
